method.tool: scratchpad/tools/coverage_search.py via search/C9/c9scan.py, seven term sets (terms.txt), --regex --whole-words; S1-S7 JSON files; the seven sets map to C9.S1..S6 (set 6 informers/torturer feeds S2 and S5; set 7 politics is S6)
method.record_check: front-matter reads (mydigest.py, fm.py, rec.py) of all 12 worlds, then each cited record read in full; claims about what a record says come from those reads
method.source_check: anchors2.py: 66 specific phrase anchors over the 313 files mapped to the 12 worlds (anchors2.json); each cited LOADED line was then read in context
method.verification: verify.py on all 33 quote records cited as RENDERED; three tool misses resolved by hand
method.layers: RENDERED = a record speaks to the sub-question (R* = partial, guard-only or draft-only); LOADED = vendored and mapped to the world, read in context, no record; IDENTIFIED = registered, unvendored; OTHER = outside the repo; NOTHING. A vendored file mapped to another movement is listed as elsewhere_in_repo, not LOADED.
